rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b on the improved data (context ledger, reply labels, corrected activity, H04's corrected nudge design): 17 replication periods re-run, NE41 re-run, two new native tests (NE32 supported, NE03 underpowered). The holdout script still uses the round-1 rule and is not run.
rationale.faithfulness: Read-out gating now holds in every regime for addressing (14/17) and for reply labels (17/17), beats a pseudo-message null and an other-room placebo (8/8), survives a non-mention content response in regime III, and every named rival including a constant delay is beaten (H = 2). NE41 holds in sign on replies and NE32 passes cleanly. Still: the talk clause fails in regime I/II, the kernel shape is a transient the step model misses, ground truth covers one agent, and nothing is confirmed on the holdout.
rationale.usefulness: Concrete, computable facts for an operator: reactions wait for the next model call (coupling delay = call cadence), a nudge acts at the target's next call so its lag is the pause schedule, compaction cuts about a fifth of conversational coupling, and fetch logs reveal silent exposure failures. Modest novelty, since gating follows from scaffold design; no validated control knob.

one_line: Responses start at the call that received the message (addressing 14/17, replies 17/17; nudges too); erasure cuts reply coupling 21%
calibrated_by: coordinator 2026-10-04 (round 1b: faithfulness 3.0 accepted, the highest so far; not holdout-confirmed)
